record.question: The 'Indian Parliament' was envisaged under
record.explanation: Answer C: Article 79 of the Constitution. Article 79 establishes the Union Parliament consisting of the President and two Houses, Council of States and House of the People. Thus Article 79 is the printed correct choice. Reference: https://www.legislative.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/08/7af1daa22d65f9d04c00ae9b9aa5a799.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
